stem:
Myra sets up two beakers, each with a water plant under an inverted funnel and a test tube. Beaker P stays in sunlight; beaker Q stays in a dark cupboard. After some time, gas collects in the tube over P, but almost none collects over Q.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The gas collected over P is rich in oxygen released during photosynthesis in sunlight.
The gas collected over P is rich in carbon dioxide released during photosynthesis.
The gas collected over P is rich in oxygen released during respiration.
The plant in sunlight does not release oxygen; only the dark setup can collect oxygen.

teacher.key_rationale: Photosynthesis in sunlight releases oxygen, matching gas over P and little gas over Q. The collected gas is not CO2 from photosynthesis, not mainly respiration oxygen, and the sunlit plant does release oxygen.
